I am currently a mathematics PhD student working under [Amie Wilkinson](https://www.math.uchicago.edu/~wilkinso/) at the University of Chicago ([Chicago, IL](/city-streets/city.html?slug=chicago)). Previously, I completed my BS/MS degree in mathematics at Carnegie Mellon University in [Pittsburgh, PA](/city-streets/city.html?slug=pittsburgh), with my thesis advised by [Ian Tice](https://www.math.cmu.edu/~iantice/). I also worked with and was advised by [Clinton Conley](https://www.math.cmu.edu/~clintonc/) and [Tomasz Tkocz](https://www.math.cmu.edu/~ttkocz/). Broadly, I am interested in most things related to dynamical systems or analysis. Currently, I am working in smooth ergodic theory, particularly the dimension theory of random diffeomorphisms. In the past, I have also thought about harmonic analysis, descriptive set theory, and function spaces in PDE.

This site collects my [math](math.qmd), along with some [other interests & projects](interests.qmd).
